<infobox theme="Ship-series">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="designer"><label>Designer</label></data>
        <data source="manufacturer"><label>Manufacturer</label></data>
        <data source="line"><label>Line</label></data>
        <data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>
        <data source="models"><label>Models</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
        <header>Usage</header>
        <data source="availability"><label>Availability</label></data>
        <data source="role"><label>Role(s)</label></data>
        <data source="firstuse"><label>Year introduced</label></data>
        <data source="retired"><label>Retired</label></data>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:ShipSeries|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

===Usage===
'''This infobox is used for both starships and vehicles.''' To use this infobox, paste the following code at the top of an article, filling all appropriate fields:
<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>{{Top|}}
{{ShipSeries
|image=
|name=
|designer=
|manufacturer=
|line=
|type=
|models=
|availability=
|role=
|firstuse=
|retired=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
